metadata.description: Small, sharp, agent-agnostic skills that keep an AI agent's work honest.

plugins.name: session-measurement
plugins.description: Measure an AI agent's per-session performance on a small, stable metric set and track it as a trend over a long run, so a model / frame / skill change shows up as a real regression or improvement. Plain-markdown trend table (canonical, zero-dependency); optional chart renderer.

plugins.name: throughline
plugins.description: Task-Track & Handoff for AI agents on long, multi-session work. Within a session it pins one ⭐️ MAIN goal in an emoji-tagged task list so the agent doesn't drift; across sessions or agents it writes a plain-markdown handoff the next agent re-derives before trusting. Not for short, one-pass tasks.

plugins.name: notify-me
plugins.description: Calls you back when an agent needs you. The moment an agent gets blocked waiting on your decision, it pushes a notification to your phone (via ntfy) and/or plays a sound on your computer, so you can step away and still know when you're needed. Hook-based, no account, no background process.
